symptom: Every combo box mxcli wrote stored customEditabilityExpression with PrimitiveValue "false" as well as Expression "false"; Studio Pro stores PrimitiveValue "" (ako/TestApp Rules.RuleAction_NewEdit). mx check accepted both, so mxcli's widgets differed from Studio Pro's and a page saved by one never re-ran Unchanged against the other
cause: A property the widget's editorConfig hides is reset to its declared default (hiddenUnnamedProperties / unmappedHiddenResets in PluggableWidgetEngine.Build), and both reset sites called builder.SetPrimitive whatever the property's value type. The template and the .mpk augment were already right (PrimitiveValue ""); the explicit `key: value` path routes by ValueType and was right too
file: mdl/executor/widget_engine.go (resetToDeclaredDefault, used by the two hidden-property reset sites)
fix: Write the declared default into the slot its value type keeps it in: SetExpression for an Expression property (PrimitiveValue left as the template's ""), SetPrimitive otherwise
insight: Measure the slots by the property's declared ValueType, read from the widget's own Type, not by a $Type pattern: over 221 TestApp + PedApp pages, snippets and layouts, 939 Expression-typed WidgetValues fill PrimitiveValue 0 times, and no other type fills Expression — strictly exclusive, which is what made the fix safe against CE0463. Bisect the pipeline before reading it: GetTemplateFullBSON already produced PrimitiveValue "", which put the defect after template load and pointed straight at the two SetPrimitive reset calls. mx check passes with and without the fix (control), so the test has to assert the stored slot, not mx
